call_points.text: FY27 capex plan maintained at ₹1,400 Cr, focused on cables, wires, and R&D.
Switchgear contribution margins returning to normalized 38% to 40% levels.
Overall volume growth in cables and wires is close to double digits.
Cables H1 contribution margins held at approximately 15%, in line with the long-term average.
Recent capacity expansions in cables have been directed toward medium voltage and high voltage.
RAC accounts for ~75% of Lloyd business, targeted to reduce to around 60% over time.
ROCE is currently close to 23%, with management comfortable targeting higher than long-term average.
Management respects new competitors investing for the long term but will leverage brand and distribution.
Rest of the portfolio held contribution margins as calibrated price hikes offset raw material inflation.
Q2FY26 other income included a ₹45.27 Cr one-time gain on sale of the Faridabad land and building.
Channel stocking for cooling products was impacted by a milder start to the summer season.
A new refrigerator plant at Ghiloth was commissioned during the quarter.

Inventory days improved to 72 from 81 and net working capital days to 44 from 49
Switchgear contribution margins normalized to 38-40% range in Q2FY27.
Cables and wires volume growth was close to double digits in Q2FY27.
Lloyd RAC business accounts for ~75% of segment revenue, with a target to reduce this to 60% via non-RAC growth.

Havells India Limited shared the earnings call recording for Q4 FY26 results via link on 22nd April 2026, signed by Sanjay Kumar Gupta.
Havells India filed the Q4 FY26 earnings call transcript discussing demand trends and cost pressures.
Havells India Limited conducted Q1FY27 earnings call on July 17, 2026, reporting resilient revenue growth despite inflationary pressures and West Asia disruptions.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹6,431.99 Cr (+34.6% YoY), net profit ₹349.22 Cr (+9.7% YoY).

Havells India's Q2FY27 investor update (22 Oct 2026) showed standalone revenue up 34.6% YoY to ₹6,417 Cr, EBITDA up 30.5% to ₹576 Cr and PAT up 11.1% to ₹353 Cr, with cables margin down on aluminium volatility and FY27 capex reiterated at ₹1,400 Cr.

Havells India Limited shared the earnings call recording for Q2 & H1 FY27 results on 22nd October 2026 via [link](https://havells.com/media/custom/corporateform/e/a/earnings_call_recording_q2_fy27.mp3).
Havells India reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue growth of 35% YoY to ₹6,432 Cr and EBITDA growth of 30% on 22 October 2026.
